subject: Kickoff logistics
text: Thanks for pulling the kickoff plan together so quickly, it looks solid. My team is aligned on the schedule and we're ready to start Monday.

subject: Sprint 1 check-in
text: Quick note to say the first sprint update looked clean. No blockers on our side, and the early wins on the network layer are encouraging.

subject: Great progress on the migration cutover
text: Team, wanted to say thank you for the weekend cutover work. Zero downtime and the dashboards you sent this morning made the exec readout easy. This is exactly the kind of execution we hoped for when we kicked this off.

subject: Documentation feedback
text: Read through the runbook documentation this week, genuinely some of the clearest vendor docs I've seen. Passing it along as a model for our other IT projects.

subject: RE: Phase 2 kickoff materials
text: These look great, no changes needed from my side. Appreciate you building in the extra buffer for UAT, that shows you're thinking ahead. Looking forward to Thursday's session.

subject: Security review passed
text: Heard back from our security team, the Phase 2 architecture passed review with zero findings. That almost never happens on the first pass, nice work.

subject: Cost savings update
text: Finance flagged that we're already tracking ahead of the projected infrastructure cost savings for this quarter. Wanted you to know that's landing well internally.

subject: Board update went well
text: Just a quick note, the board update went really well and your team's slides were a big part of that. I mentioned to my boss that this has been one of the smoothest vendor engagements we've run. Keep it up.

subject: Quick question on backup schedule
text: Small question, not a concern, just want to confirm the backup window won't overlap with our month-end batch jobs. Let me know if we need to adjust anything.

subject: Renewal conversation
text: Given how Phase 1 and 2 have gone, I want to start a conversation about extending the SOW into Phase 3 ahead of schedule. Let's find time next week.

subject: Kickoff alignment
text: Good kickoff session, appreciated how clearly you laid out the compliance mapping approach. Feels like we're starting from a strong foundation.

subject: Early policy draft feedback
text: First look at the draft policy framework, directionally this is right. A few of my analysts will send line-level comments but nothing structural.

subject: Policy framework doc - excellent work
text: This is exactly what we needed. Clear, well-organized, and it maps cleanly to our compliance requirements. My legal team had almost no comments, which never happens.

subject: Data classification workshop
text: Thanks for running the classification workshop yesterday, my team walked away with a much clearer sense of how the tiers should apply to our datasets.

subject: Thank you for the fast turnaround
text: I know I sent that data lineage question late on a Friday and didn't expect an answer until Monday. Getting a thorough response Saturday morning was above and beyond. Really appreciate the responsiveness.

subject: Access control review
text: Reviewed the access control recommendations, no pushback from our side. Straightforward and well justified.

subject: Quick compliance mapping question
text: One of our vendors asked how their certification maps to our new framework. Could your team help translate that for us this week? Not urgent.

subject: Steering committee feedback
text: Wanted to pass along that our CDO specifically called out this workstream as the model for how the other governance tracks should run. Well deserved, thank you.

subject: Audit prep update
text: Appreciate you getting ahead of the external audit prep before we even asked. That kind of foresight is exactly why this workstream runs so smoothly.

subject: Looking ahead to Q4 scope
text: Given how well this has gone, I'd like to start scoping additional Q4 governance work with your team. Can we find time in the next two weeks?

subject: Kickoff - excited to get going
text: Really looking forward to this workstream. The proposed data model looks solid and the timeline feels achievable. Let's keep the momentum from the pitch going.

subject: Sprint 1 recap
text: Good first sprint overall. Only note is our data team was slower than expected getting you warehouse access, hopefully that doesn't repeat next sprint.

subject: Data access still pending
text: Following up, the warehouse access issue from last week is still not fully resolved on our end, which I know is pushing your timeline too. Chasing it internally.

subject: RE: segmentation logic question
text: Got your question about the segmentation logic, but I need a clearer answer than what was in the doc, it read as more ambiguous than I'd like this deep into the sprint.

subject: RE: Sprint 2 demo
text: Demo was fine, though I noticed the churn model still isn't using the updated segments we discussed three weeks ago. Can we make sure that's in for Sprint 3? Don't want it to slip again.

subject: Following up on churn model fix
text: Checking in on the churn model fix from last week's demo feedback. Haven't seen an update and we're now into Sprint 3.

subject: Timeline concerns
text: I'm a little concerned we're now two sprints behind where the original plan had us. I understand things come up, but I'd like a clearer view of how we get back on track before I have to explain this upward. Can we set up a call this week instead of waiting for the regular cadence?

subject: Still no plan
text: It's been a week since our call and I still don't have the recovery plan you said would be ready by Friday. This is becoming a pattern I need to flag more formally.

subject: Following up again
text: This is the second time I've had to ask for the updated project plan after saying I needed it by end of week. I don't want to escalate this, but I need to see a concrete recovery plan, not just an apology, by Monday.

subject: Recovery plan received
text: Got the recovery plan Monday as promised, and it looks reasonable on paper. I'll withhold full confidence until we've actually hit two sprints on the new dates, but this is a step in the right direction.

subject: Kickoff expectations
text: Good to get started, though I'll be upfront that leadership is watching this one closely given how the legacy system has burned us before with other vendors. Let's start strong.

subject: Missed integration test window
text: This is the third missed test window this month. Each time it pushes our downstream teams' schedules. I need to understand what is actually going wrong here, not just that there was 'an unexpected issue.'

subject: Second follow-up on test windows
text: Another missed window this week. I raised this seven days ago and nothing has visibly changed. I need a real explanation, not a repeat apology.

subject: Unacceptable
text: I found out from my own team that the API mapping was wrong, not from your team, even though this has apparently been known for a week. I should not be the last to know about problems on my own program.

subject: RE: escalation call recap
text: Thanks for the call today. To be clear, I'm holding your team to the root cause analysis you committed to delivering today. I'll be tracking this closely.

subject: Escalating to your engagement partner
text: I've asked for a root cause analysis twice and haven't received one. I'm looping in your engagement partner because I no longer feel confident this workstream will self-correct without leadership involvement on your side.

subject: Still waiting on the RCA
text: It has now been over a week since your engagement partner committed to a root cause analysis. I have still not received it. This is exactly the pattern I raised on the escalation call.

subject: Trust concerns ahead of QBR prep
text: Ahead of next week's QBR, I want to be direct that trust with this workstream is very low right now. I intend to raise the full history in that session unless something changes materially before then.

subject: Formal concerns ahead of QBR
text: Ahead of the QBR I want it on record that this workstream has not met a milestone on time since May. We are evaluating whether this scope should be restructured or reassigned. Please come prepared to discuss both options.

subject: QBR outcome and next steps
text: Following the QBR, I want to be transparent: our leadership is now formally evaluating whether to move this workstream to a different vendor. The revised plan you presented was a reasonable start, but it will take sustained delivery, not another slide, to change that trajectory.
